evidence.exact_claim: Under D1-D3 and prototype A of D4, for every fixed K>=2 and beta>0 construct a theta-independent causal family implementing the finite-history smoothed conditional reference P_{N,s}=(a_s+lambda_N v0)/(u_s+lambda_N), lambda_N=1/(N-2), v0=1/K, to a deterministic uniform error sup_{H in [K]^N,s} TV(Pi_N(H;s),P_{N,s}) <= epsilon_N with an explicit theta-independent epsilon_N->0. Prove the complete actual circuit: charged fixed predecessor copying, K^2 ReLU context encoding, beta full-context Q/K scores, query-independent values producing matched q_s and uniform (r,mu_all), terminal frequency selection, all residual/query/length channels, and a strictly simplex probability readout covering n_s=0. Give an explicit finite resource upper bound (L,W,H,D_qk,B_param,B_arith,score_range), with defined precision semantics and accounted multiplication, reciprocal, projection or legal replacement, smoothing and rounding. Derive a deterministic located-error bound including q,r,u and query/binding errors; use the shared-statistic identity to avoid an unjustified universal u^{-2} gain. Clearly separate nominal fixed beta from arithmetic errors and fixed networks from accuracy-dependent families. This is a local actual-circuit prerequisite, not C1 or root closure.

assumptions: D1-D8 are the frozen first-stage definitions; theta is unknown at prediction time.
Stationary initialization and strictly positive symbol-successor probabilities hold per fixed theta, without a common lower bound across the rare family.
All network-visible side information and resources are charged. Primary guarantees are forward guarantees, not unproved learnability claims.
Full-context and itemwise kernels, rare and uniform process families, and distinct error models remain separately scoped.

quantifiers.domain: a D3 causal simplex-predictor family indexed by N and accuracy, with a theta-independent epsilon_N->0 implementation schedule and C1-C3 qualified guarantees
D1 second-order tables on K symbols

scope.parameter_domain: K integers >=2; N integers >=3; theta as D1; fixed beta>0 (A), beta_1,beta_2>0 (B); target accuracy epsilon>0 and failure probability alpha in (0,1); finite resource vectors as D3. Rare parameters and interaction parameters exactly as D4-D5. Additional uniform-rate bounds are explicit conditional subfamilies, not changes to the mother problem.

Include all retained query/local/length channels in the comparison, and do not infer impossibility for the undeleted sufficient representation.
